name: worldquant_iqc
description: WorldQuant International Quant Championship. Alpha expressions evaluated on WQ BRAIN.
code_skeleton:
# WQ BRAIN alpha expression (pseudocode; real submission is in the BRAIN IDE).
# Example: rank(-delta(close, 5)) -> mean-reversion factor over 5-day change.

alpha = rank(-ts_mean(returns, 10))
anti_patterns: Using look-ahead operators (future prices, future fundamentals).
Dividing by a value that can be zero (avoid implicit NaN/Inf).
Over-fit IS Sharpe that collapses OOS: IQC rewards universality, not a single period.
Ignoring neutralization: raw returns without sector/market neutralization typically underperform.
Submitting alphas with < 65% turnover — BRAIN filters these as inactive.
submission_requirements: Alpha expression using BRAIN operators only.
Positive OOS Sharpe, OOS IR, passes universality + weight checks.
past_round_notes: Cross-sectional rank operators (rank, ts_rank) generalize better than raw-scale signals.
Volatility-targeted signals (signal / std) produce steadier Sharpes.
Combining two weakly-correlated alphas via rank-averaging often beats either alone.
prompt_addendum: Context: WorldQuant IQC. Output an alpha expression using the WQ BRAIN operator set (rank, ts_mean, delta, ts_std, scale, sign, signed_power, ...). Do NOT output a Backtrader script. Optimize for OOS Sharpe, not IS.
